result.instructions: Tools for Bumpa, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which orders are paid but not shipped yet?"; "Show me sales analytics for last week, by product."; "Mark order 1042 as SHIPPED.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Bumpa data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run bumpa_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run bumpa_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run bumpa_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. bumpa_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: bumpa_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List the store's orders (paginated), filterable by status, payment and shipping status, date range and search text. Bumpa API: GET /api/commerce/v1/orders.

location_id.description: Bumpa location id. Pass it explicitly; omitted = the store default location.

limit.description: Orders per page (default set by Bumpa).

status.description: Order status filter, as Bumpa names it.

orderByField.description: Field to sort by, as Bumpa names it.

tools.name: bumpa_get_analytics
tools.title: Get analytics detail
tools.description: Get analytics detail for one type over a date range: payment-methods, sales, transactions, products, customers or campaigns. Defaults to the current Sunday-to-Saturday week. Bumpa API: GET /api/commerce/v1/analytics/{type}.

location_id.description: Bumpa location id. Pass it explicitly; omitted = the store default location.

tools.name: bumpa_get_analytics_summary
tools.title: Get analytics summary
tools.description: Get summary cards for orders, products, customers or payment-methods. Set abandoned=true with type orders for abandoned-order metrics. Bumpa API: GET /api/commerce/v1/analytics/{type}/summary.

location_id.description: Bumpa location id. Pass it explicitly; omitted = the store default location.

abandoned.description: true = abandoned-order metrics (type must be orders).

tools.name: bumpa_update_order_shipping_status
tools.title: Update order shipping status
tools.description: Set an order's shipping_status (UNFULFILLED, SHIPPED, PARTIALLY_SHIPPED, RETURNED or DELIVERED). Setting the same status again changes nothing. Bumpa API: POST /api/commerce/v1/orders/{id}/shipping.

location_id.description: Bumpa location id. Pass it explicitly; omitted = the store default location.

tools.name: bumpa_retry_shipping_booking
tools.title: Retry shipping booking
tools.description: Queue a retry of the automated shipping booking for a paid order that has automated shipping and no booking yet. The booking can carry a logistics cost. Bumpa API: POST /api/commerce/v1/orders/{id}/shipping/retry.

location_id.description: Bumpa location id. Pass it explicitly; omitted = the store default location.

tools.name: bumpa_export_orders
tools.title: Export orders (CSV by e-mail)
tools.description: Queue an asynchronous CSV export of orders matching the filters. Bumpa does not return the file: it e-mails it to the store owner. Bumpa API: POST /api/commerce/v1/orders/export.

location_id.description: Bumpa location id. Pass it explicitly; omitted = the store default location.

customer_id.description: Only orders of this customer id.
